name: optimizer_main
note: called with (argc, argv): FUN_00423970(1), initialize_optimizer(argv), process_input_functions(), terminate_optimizer(argv); argc unused

name: initialize_optimizer
note: FUN_004239b0(1, argv[1]) returns the options record (g_options); g_debug_flags = options+300; g_inline_flags from options+0xb8; init_il_node_pool(0x2000); g_alloc_node_fn = FUN_00420950 (takes a node off the free list); reads, writes and frees the first record (read_il_node / write_il_node / FUN_00420980)

name: process_input_functions
note: main loop over top-level records: IL_FUNC (4) is optimised under setjmp(g_error_jmp_buf), IL_ASM (5) passed through, any other record is written and ends the loop; calls build_register_allocation_order first; keeps the file position of each function (FUN_004296f0 = ftell) for the fallback path; "read tree"/"write tree" dumps (debug bit 2); error 0x1091/0x1092 when g_pool_bytes_outstanding != 0 after a function (leak check, off with debug bit 0x10000000)

name: build_register_allocation_order
note: fills g_gpr_alloc_order (r14..r8 from index 4; count g_gpr_alloc_count, 0xb) and g_fpr_alloc_order (registers 31..0x14+options[0x149] from index options[0x149]; count g_fpr_alloc_count, 0xc), leaving out the registers whose bit is set in the option mask at options+0x150 and lowering the counts

name: process_function_op0_inline
note: the op0inline path (options+4 == 0 and g_inline_flags & 2): read_il_operands, "op0inline read tree" dump, prepare_function_for_optimization, FUN_00406000 (unless debug 0x80000), FUN_00409ac0, "op0inline write tree" dump, write_function_and_free, leak check 0x1091/0x1092. orig: op0inline (debug strings)

name: process_function_expressions_only
note: fallback when a function is not optimised as a whole (options+4 == 0 without inline mode, or after abort_function_optimization longjmps back): FUN_00429920 (fseek) to g_function_file_pos, passes the function header through, then statement by statement: control records (op < 0x20) copied, expression trees read (read_il_operands, error 0xce6), FUN_004060b0 + FUN_004068a0 unless debug 0x80000, FUN_00409af0, written (write_il_tree) and freed; stops at the matching IL_E_BLOCK

name: abort_function_optimization
note: does not return: frees g_pending_jump_hash and the pending block lists, the loop table, leaves and pools (FUN_00415b30, FUN_0041eb50, FUN_004174e0, FUN_00413440, FUN_004058a0, FUN_00405960, FUN_00410d30, FUN_004171d0), sets g_function_aborted, reports message 100 with the function's name (FUN_004197a0), reset_symbol_leaf_numbers, reset_il_node_pool, _longjmp(g_error_jmp_buf, 1). Called on allocation failures (FUN_004081f0, FUN_00405a30, remember_leafed_symbol)

name: prepare_function_for_optimization
note: repeats FUN_0041f140 (inline mode) or FUN_004208b0 on the body (func->child) for g_body_pass_index = 0/1 .. options[0x14c]; optional FUN_00412760; then build_control_flow_graph(body), FUN_004136c0, assign_leaf_numbers(func)

name: assign_leaf_numbers
note: recursive: gives each IL_ID node its leaf number (nleaf +0x58). A symbol (symx > 0) gets a leaf from FUN_00419700 once (cached in symbol.ms_leaf, recorded by remember_leafed_symbol) with leaf flags LF_STATIC (storage class 1..4), LF_EXPVOL (symbol type & 2), LF_IMPVOL (symbol+3 != 0); temporaries (symx <= 0) are looked up by symno in the leaf table (up to g_leaf_count). An assignment-class operator (0x38/0x39/0x3c/0x3d/0x50..0x5f) inside the second operand of ?:/&&/|| (g_cond_depth) sets LF_CNDASS on its target leaf

name: optimize_function
note: the pipeline for one function: FUN_00406000 (opt_exp) rounds, FUN_00410b00 (DAG chain), FUN_00422a40, loop passes, "before lp_flat()" / "after loopflat[S]/[E]" dumps (debug 0x40000000; g_loops_flattened), common_subexpression_elimination (g_cse_changed), rebuild_cfg_and_leaves after passes that changed the tree, register allocation (FUN_00406d60), FUN_0040b530, FUN_00409ac0, leaf table dump (debug 4)

name: write_function_and_free
note: write_il_tree(func), FUN_004209a0 (free the tree), reset_symbol_leaf_numbers, FUN_004058a0, FUN_00405960(g_loop_tree) and clears it, FUN_0040dec0 in inline mode, FUN_0041edf0, FUN_00420870

name: remember_leafed_symbol
note: pushes an 8-byte record {next, symx} on g_leafed_symbols (abort_function_optimization when the allocation fails)

name: reset_symbol_leaf_numbers
note: walks g_leafed_symbols: symbol[symx].ms_leaf = 0, frees each 8-byte record

name: terminate_optimizer
note: FUN_00424a20(1, argv[1]), FUN_0040aa30, FUN_00417310, write_symbol_file when inline mode / options+0x35 / DAT_004587a0 / g_symbol_table_modified, then FUN_00429a70(g_max_error_level * 2 + 1) (exit)

name: rebuild_cfg_and_leaves
note: after a pass changed the tree: FUN_00413850, reset_symbol_leaf_numbers, frees the blocks (FUN_004058a0) and loop table (FUN_00405960), clears g_leaf_count / g_leafed_symbols / g_cond_depth, build_control_flow_graph(g_current_function->child), FUN_004136c0, assign_leaf_numbers(g_current_function); the same sequence is inline in optimize_function

name: compute_lreg_priorities_and_life_areas
note: register allocation (FUN_00406d60, after FUN_00407b30): for each logical register of g_lreg_list: WEB_CHAIN (kind 1): sort_web_chain_by_pp, priority [priori] (+4) = sum of the chain nodes' refcnt weighted by loop depth (FUN_00407b00, loop.fath chain), halved for some types when options+0x18 == 4, sets bblock.flag 0x10 on the chain's blocks; a web of a class 7/8 symbol with priority <= 2 and an occurrence in block 1 whose type fails the register-size checks (FUN_0041aca0) becomes DELETE_WEB (kind 3); otherwise each chain node gets its life area (compute_web_node_life_area with g_current_lreg). CONST_DATA (kind 0): compute_const_life_area

name: compute_const_life_area
note: reg: proposed struct lreg (0x2c, kind CONST_DATA). choose_const_dominator, then by the reg_const's dominator type (+2): NO_DOM adds every block's [startpp,endpp]; EX_DOM walks each use back to the dominator (mark_const_uses_on_paths, extend_const_life_area_backward), picks the latest use node per block and adds a range from it; SELF_DOM adds one range from the statement of the latest use. Ranges via make_life_area_entry pushed on reg->life (+0xc) | typed: reg+0x20 chain read as const_data (+02 dom_type 0/1, +08 uses as const_use {next, block +4, node +8, flag +10}, +14 dom_block, +18 dom_node); reg+0x0c life list head prepended with make_life_area_entry cells; called from compute_lreg_priorities_and_life_areas

name: choose_const_dominator
note: reg: proposed lreg (CONST_DATA); its reg_const (+0x20): all uses in one block that is in no loop -> SELF_DOM (2), dom_block = that block, dom_node = first use; otherwise the common dominator of the use blocks (FUN_0041e630) -> EX_DOM (1), moved to the outermost loop's pre-header (loop.pre +0x2c); dom_node = the use inside that block or the block's last statement. Values as printed by the lreg dump (00414820: NO_DOM/EX_DOM/SELF_DOM) | typed: reg+0x20 = const_data: +08 uses (const_use: +4 block, +8 node), sets +02 dom_type 1/2, +14 dom_block, +18 dom_node

name: mark_const_uses_on_paths
note: recursive over predecessors (prelst) up to the constant's dominator block: marks reg_const uses in the visited blocks (use flag bit 1, +0x10) and the blocks (bblock.flag 0x200 via byte +0x65 bit 2); link = the prelst entry the walk came through (its successors in that list are walked too); reg: proposed lreg | typed: reg+0x20 = const_data (+14 dom_block compared with block, +08 uses: const_use.block +4, flag +10 |= 1); recursive with the same reg

name: extend_const_life_area_backward
note: same walk as mark_const_uses_on_paths, adding each unmarked block's whole [startpp,endpp] to reg's life area (make_life_area_entry pushed on reg+0xc) and marking it (flag 0x200) | typed: reg+0x0c life list (prepends make_life_area_entry cells), reg+0x20 const_data.dom_block (+14) as the stop block

name: sort_web_chain_by_pp
note: reg: proposed lreg; bubble-sorts its web chain (+0x20, proposed du_node linked through +8) by the pp (+0x44) of each node's il_node (+0x10) | typed: reg+0x20 chain is a dutbl list: next +08, node +10, node.pp +44 compared; writes reg+0x20 (new head)

name: any_bit_set
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: unsigned char any_bit_set(unsigned int *set, int nwords)
note: 1 when any of nwords words is non-zero; used on the 0x10-word results of FUN_00406c30 (bit-set AND). Callers 00402a70, 00402d10, 00407000 test the result as a byte (00402d10 compares CONCAT31(extraout, b) == 1)

name: compute_web_node_life_area
note: chain_node: proposed du_node. Computes the pp range [start,end] over which this chain node keeps the web live (from the node's pp to its statement, to the block end when the leaf's use set (g_leaf_table use) meets the block's l_in/out, or from the block start for the first node, g_first_chain_node) and pushes it (make_life_area_entry) on g_current_lreg->life; when it reaches the block end, add_block_to_life_area on successors whose l_in meets the leaf's use set | typed: +00 kind (==2 definition), +04 links (node_list; link->node->duptr->block compared with +0c), +0c block (startpp +58, endpp +5a, out +14, l_in +18, suclst +0c), +10 node (pp +44, flag +5e, parent +10, cmnexp +3c, nleaf +58)

name: add_block_to_life_area
note: adds [startpp,endpp] of block to g_current_lreg's life area, sets bblock.flag 8, recurses into successors (suclst) without flag 8/0x10 whose l_in (+0x18) meets the use set of the web's leaf

name: make_life_area_entry
note: finds or creates the 0xc-byte proposed life_range {next, lregs, start, end} in g_life_ranges_by_pp[start_pp], adds g_current_lreg to its lreg list (8-byte {next, lreg}), returns a new 8-byte link {next, range} for the caller to push on lreg->life (+0xc). Sizes from FUN_004081f0(8)/(0xc)

name: coalesce_copy_webs
note: for each WEB_CHAIN whose only definition (find_single_definition) is an assignment '_' of a register-sized value copied from a variable with its own web (via duptr): binds it to that web's lreg (+0x18 bind; appended to the target's +0x24 bakbind chain) when definition_outside_life_areas; then merges every bound lreg into its root (merge_bound_lreg). Dump names [bind]/[bakbind] (00414820)

name: merge_bound_lreg
note: dst/src: proposed lreg. Drops src clash entries already in dst, appends src's chain (+0x20), life area (+0xc) and clash list (+0x10) to dst, src becomes DELETE_WEB (kind 3) with its lists cleared, dst priori += src priori - 2, removes dst's self-clashes and repoints the other lregs' clash entries from src to dst | typed: both: +02 set (src := 3 DELETE(WEB)), +04 priori summed, +0c life, +10 clashed ({next, lreg *} cells), +20 chain (dutbl list walked by +08); caller coalesce_copy_webs passes g_lreg_list entries and their +18 bind

name: find_single_definition
note: chain: first proposed du_node; returns the only node of kind 2 (definition) when there is exactly one, else 0 (return width 4) | typed: counts records with +00 kind == 2 walking +08 next; returns the one definition or 0; callers pass lreg.chain (+20) and read the result's +10 node (op '_', val3 +28 = lreg)

name: definition_outside_life_areas
note: reg: proposed lreg, def: du_node. 1 when the pp of def's il_node lies outside every life range of reg and of the lregs bound to it (recursive over bind and bakbind), else 0 | typed: reg: +0c life cells {next, lifetbl *} (lifetbl st +08 / en +0a vs def->node->pp), +24 bakbind recursion; def: +10 node, node.val3 (+28) = lreg whose +18 bind / +20 chain are followed

name: build_lreg_clash_lists
note: for every pp 1..g_pp_count-1, every life range starting there and every lreg in it: add_clashes_for_range; builds the [clashed lregs] lists (+0x10)

name: add_clashes_for_range
note: lreg_link: 8-byte {next, lreg} in range's lreg list; range: proposed life_range. Clashes its lreg with the rest of that list, with the lregs of later ranges at the same start pp, and with every lreg of the ranges starting in (start, end] (the end pp itself only when the lreg is bound (+0x18) or end is the endpp of a block) via add_lreg_clash | typed: range: +00 next lifetbl (same start), +04 lregs list, +08 st, +0a en; build_lreg_clash_lists passes g_lifehash_buckets entries; lreg_link stays void * (a {next, lreg *} cell, no record)

name: add_lreg_clash
note: links {next, lreg}: when the two lregs differ and do not yet clash, pushes each on the other's clash list (+0x10)

name: compute_lreg_profits
note: for each lreg: profit (+8) = priori (+4) - average priori of its clashing lregs (dump "priori=%d, profit=%d")

name: statement_pp
note: climbs parents to the statement root (flag 0x200, set per statement by FUN_00406f80) and returns its pp (+0x44)

name: common_subexpression_elimination
note: clears g_value_number, g_cse_nesting, g_cse_cond_depth, g_cse_has_goto_or_label, g_cse_in_builtin_call; cse_mark_unchained_blocks, cse_number_statements(g_current_function), cse_replace_in_blocks, cse_free_hash_tables. The caller (optimize_function) clears g_cse_changed before and rebuilds the CFG and leaves when it is set

name: cse_mark_unchained_blocks
note: for every block in creation order (bn_next from g_first_block) whose f_next and b_next are both 0 (not on the depth-first chain), cse_mark_subtree_skipped on each of its statements

name: cse_mark_subtree_skipped
note: sets flag2 (+0x60) bit 1 on node and every operand; cse_number_expression skips such nodes

name: cse_number_statements
note: walks node's operands: recurses into IL_BLOCK, skips IL_NULL, numbers every other statement with cse_number_expression

name: cse_number_expression
note: value-numbering walk (val_no +0x44, class head +0x48, class next +0x4c, refcnt +0x5c): IL_GOTO/IL_GLABEL set g_cse_has_goto_or_label; IF/FOR/WHILE/DO/SWITCH operands at g_cse_nesting+1; op class 0x80 (?:, &&, ||) via cse_number_conditional; otherwise operands first (g_cse_in_builtin_call while inside a call to a builtin listed at 004342d0, FUN_004073f0), then by g_il_op_class: 1 cse_number_constant, 2 cse_number_identifier, 4/8 and indirection of some types cse_number_operator, else cse_clear_value_number

name: cse_number_conditional
note: first operand normally, the others with g_cse_cond_depth + 1, then cse_clear_value_number(node)

name: cse_number_constant
note: joins an equal constant's class (cse_find_constant, cse_join_value_class); else, outside conditional operands, cse_new_value_number + cse_add_constant

name: cse_number_identifier
note: skips address-taken (parent IL_AMPER), struct/union typed, volatile and LF_STATIC/LF_CNDASS/LF_IMPVOL leaves; an assignment target (parent op class 0x20, first operand) starts a value (g_leaf_table lastnd = node, cse_record_leaf_definition) or, when the leaf already has one, cse_count_leaf_redefinition; a use joins the leaf's current definition or, when not nested/conditional/goto, starts a value

name: cse_number_operator
note: when every operand has a value number: joins an equal expression (cse_find_expression, cse_join_value_class) or, when not nested/conditional/goto, cse_new_value_number + cse_add_expression; else cse_clear_value_number

name: cse_clear_value_number
note: refcnt (+0x5c) = 0, class head (+0x48) = 0, val_no (+0x44) = 0, class next (+0x4c) = 0

name: cse_join_value_class
note: node->+0x48 = head, inserted after head in the +0x4c chain, takes head's val_no (a fresh number when head has none), head refcnt += 1 unless struct/union typed

name: cse_new_value_number
note: node heads its own class: refcnt 1, +0x48 = node, +0x4c = 0, val_no = ++g_value_number

name: cse_add_constant
note: pushes {next, node} on g_const_hash[(val + val2 + val3) % 16]; allocation failure -> cse_abort_out_of_memory

name: cse_find_constant
note: looks node up in g_const_hash with FUN_0040a460 (node equality); returns the equal node or 0

name: cse_record_leaf_definition
note: adds {next, leafno, count 1} for node's leaf to g_leaf_def_hash (128 buckets by leaf number)

name: cse_count_leaf_redefinition
note: increments the definition count of node's leaf in g_leaf_def_hash

name: cse_add_expression
note: pushes {node, next} on g_expr_hash[(op + val_no(op1) + val_no(op2)) % 128]

name: cse_find_expression
note: finds a node with the same operator, a compatible type and the same operand value numbers (either order for op class bit 8, commutative) in g_expr_hash; 0 when an operand heads its own class or nothing matches

name: cse_abort_out_of_memory
note: cse_free_hash_tables then abort_function_optimization

name: cse_replace_in_blocks
note: cse_replace_in_block for every block of the depth-first chain after the first (g_block_order_head->f_next onwards)

name: cse_replace_in_block
note: for each statement entry of block->ilnode: entry->node = cse_replace_in_tree(entry->node, entry, block)

name: cse_replace_in_tree
note: RETURN TYPE CHANGE (lead to decide): the sig line has undefined (void) but the value is used by 00403eb0 (stores it) and by its own recursion (follows ->next of the result); the result is cse_check_common_expression's return left in EAX. Post-order over the operands, then cse_check_common_expression(node, stmt, block)

name: cse_check_common_expression
note: when node is in g_expr_hash: if its leaves are not all defined once (cse_single_definition_status != 1) unlinks its class chain (+0x4c) and returns it; else returns cse_replace_with_temporary(node, stmt, block). Otherwise returns node

name: cse_single_definition_status
note: IL_ID: its leaf's definition count from g_leaf_def_hash (0 when absent); IL_CONST: 1; other: 1 when every operand gives 1, else the first other value

name: cse_replace_with_temporary
note: for a class head of register type used more than once (refcnt > 1 and more than its parent's, or under an assignment operator 0x50..0x5f): sets g_cse_changed, puts (temp = node) in node's place (FUN_00421020(IL_ASSIGN, type), FUN_00421150 new temporary, FUN_00420e60, FUN_00420dd0) and replaces every other class member (+0x4c chain) with a copy of the temporary (FUN_00420c50, FUN_00420aa0), fixing the statement entries in block and the following blocks (f_next); returns the node now in node's place. stmt unused

name: cse_free_hash_tables
note: frees the g_leaf_def_hash entries (clearing g_leaf_table lastnd of each leaf), g_const_hash and g_expr_hash (8-byte entries) and clears the buckets

name: write_symbol_file
note: when the symbol table grew (options+0xb0 > g_initial_symbol_count) or g_symbol_table_modified: opens options+0x6c (FUN_00429ce0 = fopen, mode string at 004334f0; error 0xce4) as g_symbol_file and writes each used symbol 1..options+0xb0: index, class, class-dependent short, name length + name, type, aggregate size, bytes +6/+7/+0x2e, short +0x16, byte +0x38, then function info / init info / class 10 lists / class 9 int +0x18; fclose error 0xce5

name: write_symbol_init_info
note: (symbol byte +7 bit 0x10) writes byte +0x2d, then +0x30 (2 bytes when +0x2d bit 4, else 4) when +0x2d bit 2, then the int +0x34 when +0x2d bit 1. "init" is a reading of the flag, confirm

name: write_symbol_class
note: one byte (symbol+0) to g_symbol_file

name: write_symbol_class_short
note: writes value (symbol+4) only for classes 3, 4, 9 and 11

name: write_symbol_name_length
note: one byte (symbol.name_len +2)

name: write_symbol_name
note: writes len bytes of name when len != 0

name: write_symbol_type
note: one byte (symbol+1, the type byte in il_node.type's encoding: read_il_node copies it into IL_ID nodes)

name: write_symbol_aggregate_size
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void write_symbol_aggregate_size(unsigned char type, int size)
note: writes size (symbol+8) only when (type & 0xe0) >= 0x60 (struct/union/array kinds)

name: write_symbol_byte_06
note: one byte (symbol+6); the field's meaning is not known

name: write_symbol_function_info
note: for class 1/3 with type 0x48: the record at sym+0x10: type byte (+4) and size (+0), byte +5, a byte count (+6) of symbol numbers (shorts at +0xc) each followed by that symbol's type byte, a short count (+8) of shorts (+0x10). "function" is a reading of type 0x48 + a parameter-like list; confirm

name: write_symbol_class10_lists
note: class 10: the record at sym+0x10: a short count (+0) of shorts (+4), then a short count (+2) of symbol numbers (+8) each followed by that symbol's type byte

name: write_symbol_bytes
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void write_symbol_bytes(FILE *fp, char *buf, unsigned int size)
note: FUN_004254f0 (fwrite) with error 0xce7

name: read_il_node
note: gets a node from g_alloc_node_fn (error 0x109b when unset), reads op and the op-dependent fields (symx, type/size, constant value sized by const_value_size, asm number/size, call fields, qualify fields) and filn/line/listno (+0xa/+0xc/+0x32) from the .ila file (read_ila_bytes); IL_ID takes its type from symbol+1; 0 when no node

name: const_value_size
note: bytes of a constant by type & 0xfc: 0x30 -> 8, 0x38 -> 12, else 4

name: write_il_node
note: mirror of read_il_node to the .ilb file (write_ilb_bytes), adding lreg (+0x30) for IL_ID, blkflg (+0x20 byte) for IL_BLOCK/IL_E_BLOCK and FR0set (+0x62) for IL_ID and A_ADD/A_SUB/A_MUL/A_DIV/ASSIGN/COMMA

name: read_node_type
note: reads the type byte (+3) and, for kinds 0x60/0x70/0x80/0x90 (struct/union/array), the size (+0x20)

name: write_node_type
note: writes the type byte and, for kinds 0x60/0x70/0x80/0x90, the size (+0x20)

name: read_il_operands
note: reads node's operands (count from g_il_op_operand_count, a short per operator) with read_il_tree and links them (child/next/parent); an IL_BLOCK stops at its IL_E_BLOCK, an IL_ARG at its IL_E_ARG; returns node, or 0 when the input ends early

name: read_il_tree
note: RETURN TYPE CHANGE (lead to decide): the sig line has undefined (void) but read_il_operands uses the result; read_il_node, then read_il_operands on it; the node (or 0) stays in EAX

name: write_il_tree
note: writes node, its operands (recursively) and its following siblings (next)

name: init_il_node_pool
note: g_il_node_pool = FUN_00417270(0x68, count) (error 0xbcd when 0), g_il_node_pool_count = count, reset_il_node_pool

name: reset_il_node_pool
note: g_free_il_nodes = g_il_node_pool, FUN_004172d0

name: read_ila_bytes
note: FUN_00425490 (fread) from g_input_file; error 0xce6 when it returns 0 or -1

name: write_ilb_bytes
note: FUN_004254f0 (fwrite) to g_output_file; error 0xce7

name: allocate_il_node_block
note: allocates count 0x68-byte nodes in one block (smaller counts via __ftol on failure, error 0xbcd below 11), chains them through next (+0x18) into g_il_node_block_list; caller FUN_0041ef30 (inline mode)

name: copy_loop_body_blocks
note: appends copies of the statements of the loop's body block (lp->start for IL_DO, lp->exit otherwise) copies times (FUN_00420c50 copy, FUN_00420dd0, FUN_004059c0); dump "after cp_lpblk" with B%d / tcount / ilnode (debug 0x1000). orig: cp_lpblk. Caller FUN_00411b70

name: link_blocks_reverse_postorder
note: depth-first over successors (suclst), flag = 1 marks visited; each finished block is pushed at the head of the f_chain (f_next +0x20 / b_next +0x24): g_block_order_head, g_block_order_tail

name: build_control_flow_graph
note: clears the CFG state, creates the entry block (FUN_00405660), cfg_start_block(1), cfg_add_statement(body), connects the pending block lists (FUN_004055f0) and g_pending_jump_hash, sets g_exit_block, link_blocks_reverse_postorder(g_first_block), FUN_004165e0, builds the loop tree (FUN_00405af0, FUN_00405b80); dump "mk_cfg after" + loop table (debug 0x800). orig: mk_cfg

name: cfg_add_statement
note: by operator: IL_BLOCK recurses up to IL_E_BLOCK, IL_EMPTY ignored, SWITCH/IF/FOR/WHILE/DO/RETURN/BREAK/CONTINUE/GOTO/GLABEL/CLABEL/DLABEL to their builders (FUN_00421920 .. FUN_004164c0; GOTO sets g_has_goto, DLABEL g_has_default_label), anything else cfg_append_statement

name: cfg_append_statement
note: appends stmt to the current block's statement list (node_list, tail g_current_block_tail); when no list is open, the open block becomes the current one (lptbl = g_current_loop, pending fall-through predecessors connected) and a new open block is created; tcount += 1

name: cfg_start_block
note: the open block becomes the current one (no statements, lptbl = g_current_loop, pending predecessors connected), a new open block is created; fall_through != 0 makes the current block the pending fall-through predecessor (g_pending_fallthrough)

name: cfg_add_edge
note: unless to is already in from->suclst: conses to onto from->suclst and from onto to->prelst (FUN_00405630)

name: add_edges_from_list_and_free
note: for each cell: FUN_004055b0(cell->block, to) (004055b0 = add a CFG edge: pushes to onto from->suclst and from onto to->prelst unless already there), then frees the 8-byte cell

name: new_list_cell
note: allocates an 8-byte list cell {item, next} (cell[0]=param_2, cell[1]=param_1); cfg_out_of_memory on failure; used for prelst/suclst (004055b0) and node lists | typed: builds an 8-byte {item, next} cell = block_list (+0 block, +4 next); every caller passes a bblock as item (g_cfg_cur_block, g_switch_block, cfg_add_edge from/to, mk_cfg_* to/item) and a block_list as next (g_cfg_pending_jumps/break/continue jumps, bblock.suclst/prelst, label_rec.gotos in cfg_goto); results are stored into block_list * globals and suclst/prelst

name: new_bblock
note: allocates bblock 0x68 + bblock_sets 0x14 + bit sets 0x20 x4 and 0x40 x4; at most 0x100 blocks (g_block_count); links the previous block's bn_next (g_last_block+0x28); number = ++g_block_count

name: free_bblock
note: frees the ilnode cells, suclst, prelst, every bit set, sets and the 0x68 block (mirror of new_bblock)

name: free_all_bblocks
note: walks g_first_block by bn_next calling free_bblock; clears g_first_block and g_f_chain; debug 0x1000 prints "bbnd free" / " No.%d,"; orig: bbnd free

name: wrap_in_block_pair
note: new IL_BLOCK (8) and IL_E_BLOCK (9) nodes with blkflg (val bit 0); 00420e60 inserts the block node as stmt's parent, 00420f20 puts the e_block after stmt

name: free_loop_tree
note: frees a loop, its children (recursive) and the following loops (next chain), 0x3c bytes each; debug 0x1000 " free lptbl LP%d"; orig: free lptbl

name: append_list_item
note: walks the next links to the end and links a new 8-byte cell holding item (the cell's next is not written: relies on the pool returning zeroed memory) | typed: stores item in node_list.node; every caller passes an il_node: copy_loop_body_blocks (copy_tree result), invert_loop_to_guarded_do, rewrite_loop_count_down, insert_in_loop_preheader (assign), reduce_induction_variable (new IL_ASSIGN), cse_append_temp_assign (new IL_ASSIGN); the heads are bblock.ilnode lists

name: push_list_item
note: prepends an 8-byte cell holding item; caller 0040c2d0 | typed: stores item in node_list.node; the only caller, assign_final_value_after_loop, passes stmt (il_node *) onto bblock.ilnode

name: cfg_out_of_memory
note: called when an allocation fails (00405630, 00405660, 004059c0, 00405a00, 00421a80 ...): frees the 256 buckets at 00458ae0 and the lists 00450718/00458f0c/004587b8/00458ee4, then FUN_004015e0 (the fatal cleanup, which repeats those frees and more)

name: free_list_cells
note: frees every 8-byte cell of a list (node_list or block_list)

name: prune_loops
note: for each loop at this level: if start->b_next (bblock+0x24) is 0 or lp_flag & 0x804, unlinks it (front/next), clears lptbl of the blocks start..exit (bn_next walk) and free_loop_tree; else recurses into child; returns the new first loop. Why b_next==0 removes a loop is not known

name: number_loops
note: post-order: lpnumber = ++g_loop_count, brc (+0x38) = that number (+depth for the last loop of a chain), nestcnt = 1 + max child nestcnt

name: dump_ilnode_list
note: prints "%s," with the uppercase op name (00433270) of each node; block dump [ilnode]

name: dump_block_list
note: prints "B%d," for each block; block dump [prelst]/[suclst]

name: dump_loop_table
note: prints LP%d, BRC No., type ENTER/EXIT, start/exit/pre, child/fath/next/front, lstep, repet, nestcnt, flag bits; recursive into child

name: dump_cfg_blocks
note: prints every block from g_first_block (bn_next): tcount, ilnode, prelst, suclst, domlst, lpnumber, flag; then the f_chain (g_f_chain) and b_chain (g_b_chain) orders

name: opt_exp_all_blocks
note: opt_exp_block for every block after the first on the f_chain, then g_opt_exp_pass++

name: opt_exp_block
note: each statement: dump "cnt_expblk", opt_exp, dump "opt_exp after"; report_fold_warnings on the first pass (g_opt_exp_pass == 0)

name: opt_exp
note: recursive expression optimiser: clears flag bits 2/0x40/0x800; if 00458f08 != 0 only FUN_004105b0 + children; else 00421b20, 00421eb0, set_value_used_flag, children, discard_unused_values, fold_constants, 00416fe0, 00416710, 0040e150, expand_unsigned_float_assign (FPU targets), discard_unused_values; sets unknown_5b = 1 + children's (subtree node count) and flag 0x800 (contains a call, from IL_CALL); orig: probably opt_exp (dump label "opt_exp after" printed after its call)

name: discard_unused_values
note: node whose value is unused (flag 0x20 clear), not a call/inc/dec/assignment (0x30-0x3d, 0x50-0x5f), not volatile: no side-effecting operand (flag 0x42) -> replaced by IL_NULL (0x6f) with warning 10; one -> replaced by that operand; several -> becomes IL_COMMA; not for &&, ||, ?:. Then recomputes flag 2 (side effect) and 0x40 (volatile) from the operands

name: set_value_used_flag
note: sets flag 0x20 ([usef]) from the parent's operator and the operand position (004209d0); debug 0x20 prints "fath==>%10s, usef=%d,pos=%d,   ndp==>%10s, usef=%d"

name: fold_constants
note: operator with constant operands (fold table 00433a68 by op, or a cast): a new IL_CONST computed by the table function for the arithmetic class, convert_constant to the result type, replaces the node; result codes 1/4/6 set g_fold_warnings 2/4/8; debug 0x40 "folding" / "folding change"

name: type_arith_class
note: 0 signed integer, 1 unsigned integer or pointer, 2 float (0x28), 3 double (0x30), 4 long double (0x38); other types return an uninitialised local

name: convert_constant
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void convert_constant(unsigned char to_type, unsigned char from_type, unsigned int *src, unsigned int *dst)
note: conversion function from table 004338f8[class(from)][class(to)], else a 1/2/3-word copy; then sign/zero-extends char and short results. In fold_constants's cast case param_1 is the cast's type and param_2 the operand's

name: report_fold_warnings
note: g_fold_warnings bit 2 -> warning 0x4b1, 4 -> 0x4b0, 8 -> 0x9c5 (FUN_004197a0(code, node, 0)); clears g_fold_warnings

name: expand_unsigned_float_assign
note: on an IL_ASSIGN: float target -> expand_unsigned_to_float, unsigned int/long target -> expand_float_to_unsigned. LEAD: Ghidra's sig is void, but EAX is always node (both callees return it, the fall-through keeps it in EAX) and opt_exp uses the result

name: expand_unsigned_to_float
note: RHS = (float)(unsigned int x): rewritten with a temp, tmp<0 ? (float)tmp + 4294967296.0f (0x4f800000) : (float)tmp; returns its argument

name: expand_float_to_unsigned
note: RHS = (unsigned)(float x): rewritten with a temp and a 2147483648.0f (0x4f000000) compare/subtract; returns its argument

name: bitset_and
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void bitset_and(unsigned int *dst, unsigned int *a, unsigned int *b, char nwords)
note: dst[i] = b[i] & a[i]

name: bitset_or
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void bitset_or(unsigned int *dst, unsigned int *a, unsigned int *b, char nwords)
note: dst[i] = b[i] | a[i]

name: bitsets_differ
note: 1 if any word differs (all words are compared), else 0

name: dump_bitset
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void dump_bitset(unsigned int *bits, int nwords, char *title)
note: prints "[[[ %s ]]]" then each word as 32 "%1d" bits to stdout (004360e8)

name: allocate_registers
note: register allocation driver: debug bit 0x04000000 skips it ("REGISTER ALLOCATION NOT RUN"); "TARGET FUNCTION NAME <%s>"; prepare_register_allocation, weigh_common_expression_candidates, phases g_regalloc_phase 1..3 (004020a0, 0041af70 "after physicalreg", 0041c6b0 ...), dumps (tree, loop table, leaf table, "after blockreg"), number_expps on the function

name: prepare_register_allocation
note: for each f_chain block: startpp, flag 0x200 on each statement root, scan_tree_for_regalloc on it, endpp (g_pp_counter); g_regalloc_block = the block

name: scan_tree_for_regalloc
note: post-order: pp numbers; record_register_variable_use; calls (function node flag 0x400, block flag |= 2, call list g_call_list unless a builtin); LASTUSE (flag 0x100) from the leaf use set & the block out set; webs (mark_web_allocatable, join_related_webs, new_register_candidate kind 1, "mkweb after web"); collect_register_candidate; mark_fr0_fmac_uses on FPU targets; with_siblings follows next

name: is_builtin_name
note: 1 if name is in the _builtin_ name table 004342d0 (strcpy ... fsrra, 49 names)

name: mark_web_allocatable
note: leaf not CNDASS/IMPVOL/EXPVOL with an integer/pointer/float (double on cpu 4) type: sets flag bit 4 on the node, its refchn and every node on its web list (recursive, joining the web chains at +8); returns 1, else 0

name: join_related_webs
note: for each web in the node's web chain: refchn nodes whose parent is an inc/dec/compound assignment of the same leaf (nleaf) get mark_web_allocatable + recursion, and their web is appended to the chain (web+8); probably part of [mkweb]

name: collect_register_candidate
note: common-expression head (cmnexp == node): variables of storage class 1..4 not excluded, or constants FUN_004198a0 says cannot be immediates (not builtin args): pushed on the current block's list at bblock+0x34 (g_regalloc_block)

name: subtree_has_symbol_attr_2e
note: 1 if the subtree has an IL_ID whose symbol (symx > 0) has symbol+0x2e & 3; such a symbol keeps an expression out of the candidates (00407720)

name: new_register_candidate
note: allocates a 0x2c record appended to the candidate list (head 00448264, tail 0044826c, link +0x14); +2 kind, +0x20 source (web chain for kind 1, expression group for kind 0); kind 1: each kind-2 web's node gets the record at il_node+0x28 | typed: allocates 0x2c (sizeof lreg), links through +0x14 (lreg.next), writes kind to +2 (lreg.set) and source to +0x20 (lreg.chain); kind 1 walks source as dutbl (+0 kind == 2, +8 next, +0x10 node) and stores the record in il_node+0x28 (val3, the web's lreg); callers use the result as an lreg: allocate_block_registers (*lr = pregno, lr[0x14] = +0x28 lregno), add_memory_lregs (*p = memory id, stored in g_lreg_table), weigh_common_expression_candidates (+4 priori, +0x20 chain->uses->node). source stays void * (dutbl * for kind 1, const_data * for kind 0, the memory record for kind 2)

name: count_enclosing_loops
note: counts the IL_FOR/IL_WHILE/IL_DO ancestors up to the IL_FUNC node

name: weigh_common_expression_candidates
note: hash_common_expression_candidate for every block's candidate list (+0x34); then each group in the 128 buckets at 00448270: weight = sum over refs of (loop depth cost) x (uses that are not immediates); weight > 1 -> new_register_candidate(group, 0) with weight at +4 (halved for double on cpu 4, +1 for function addresses); clears the buckets. Notes: the register-variable weight of a common expression

name: hash_common_expression_candidate
note: key: constant value (kind 0) or nleaf (kind 1 aggregates/functions, kind 4 storage class 1..4); finds or creates the 0x1c group in bucket key&0x7f of 00448270 (alloc chain 00448498) and adds a 0x14 ref {next, block, node}; FPU targets keep float and integer constants with the same bits apart

name: record_register_variable_use
note: register-variable reference (temp, class 5/6, or 7/8 when FUN_0041aca0 is under the limit): adds a 0x14 ref {next, block, node} to the group for nleaf in bucket nleaf&0x7f of 00440060, creating the 0x1c group if needed

name: regalloc_alloc
note: FUN_00417120(size); on failure FUN_004015e0 (fatal cleanup). Ghidra param type SIZE_T (4 bytes)

name: link_def_use_webs
note: link_def_use_webs_in_tree for every statement of every f_chain block

name: link_def_use_webs_in_tree
note: IL_ID (not array) whose cmnexp head is an assignment/inc/dec: the last refchn node's web gets the head on its list (kind 1, use) and the head's web gets the node (kind 2, def); an assignment with a web is kind 2

name: number_expps
note: gives each statement-level expression an [expp] number (il_node+0x54) from g_expp_counter, recursing into statements; skips IL_NULL in a for's non-condition slots and in return

name: is_mac_builtin_name
note: 1 if name is _builtin_macw, _builtin_macwl, _builtin_macl or _builtin_macll (table 00434398)

name: mark_fr0_fmac_uses
note: float common expression used as an IL_MUL operand under IL_ADD/IL_A_ADD at least twice: sets [FR0set] (il_node+0x62 bit 0) on those nodes (fmac takes FR0); called only for FPU targets

name: dump_tree
note: known: dumps a tree; TREE DUMP banner and "<%s>" title, flushes stdout

name: dump_tree_rec
note: known: dumps a tree; dump_tree_node then the children, with the per-depth "more siblings" flags (004371e8)

name: dump_tree_node
note: known: dumps one node (op name, type, filn/line/listno, symx, lreg, ms_leaf, nleaf, pp, expp, refcnt, flag, LASTUSE, flag2, FR0set, ivno, invno, c/s/f/n, cmnexp, refchn)

name: dump_qualify_fields
note: IL_QUALIFY/IL_B_QUALIFY: "ofst=%d" (val2) and "boff=%d bsiz=%d" (bytes +1/+2) for the bit-field form

name: dump_constant_value
note: val=%u/"val=%d" for integers, the bytes for float/double/long double (4/8/12), "tend=%d offs=%d" for pointers

name: dump_value_bytes
note: val= then count bytes in hex

name: dump_type
note: type= const/volatile, char/short/int/long, float/double/long double, func/pointer/struct/array/void, unsigned

name: dump_leaf_table
note: LEAF TABLE: No., name (TEMP%d for symno <= 0), symno, flag, gen, use; with debug 0x08000000 the LF_* flags, the lastnd tree and the GEN/USE bit sets

name: dump_loop_tree_titled
note: loop table dump banner with title, dump_loop_tree(lp, 0)

name: dump_loop_tree
note: indented "CUR", nestcnt/lpnumber, lp_flag, startcfg/exitcfg/precfg for each loop, recursive into child

name: dump_block_table
note: basic block table dump: number, startpp/endpp, lptbl, startexpp/endexpp, usepreg, usefreg, suclist, prelist, bn_next, b_trelst; with debug bits 0x03000000 the d_in/l_in/_out sets and the local static datas

name: dump_block_numbers
note: %5d: for each block, a line break every 11

name: eliminate_dead_stores
note: every statement (f_chain, skipping the first block): eliminate_dead_stores_in_tree, dump label "ggg" (debug 0x20000); when g_dead_store_changed reruns 00410b00/0040c380 first and 00410d30 after

name: eliminate_dead_stores_in_tree
note: set_value_used_flag, children (post-order, continuing from each returned child's next), then eliminate_dead_store. LEAD: Ghidra's sig is void, but it returns 00409450's EAX and both callers (itself, 00409390) use the result

name: eliminate_dead_store
note: assignment/inc/dec whose web has no use outside itself: pre inc/dec -> x+1/x-1 (1 typed per type), post inc/dec -> x, compound assignment -> the plain operator (op-0x10) with casts, '=' -> its RHS; sets g_dead_store_changed; returns the replacement

name: mark_referenced_functions
note: mark_referenced_functions_in_tree on every statement of every block (g_first_block, bn_next)

name: mark_referenced_functions_in_tree
note: IL_ID of a function (type 0x48) whose symbol+0x2e has bit 0x80: bit cleared (any reference when symbol+7 bit 0x40 is clear, only a non-call reference when it is set); sets g_function_refs_changed

name: build_dag
note: DAG/common-expression chaining by the op class table 00435320: 0x80 (&&, ||, ?:) -> dag_conditional; operands first; then const -> dag_constant, id -> dag_variable, unary/commutative -> dag_operator, qualify/indirection -> dag_indirection or dag_operator, assignment/inc/dec -> dag_assignment, call -> clear + invalidate memory; constants in builtin-call args are not chained (g_in_builtin_call). Caller 00410b40 ("DAG chain start")

name: dag_conditional
note: the first operand normally, the others with g_conditional_depth raised (no new chain heads there), then clears the node's own links

name: dag_constant
note: equal constant in the constant hash -> link_common_chain; else (unless conditional) start_common_chain + add_constant_to_hash

name: dag_variable
note: IL_ID: links to the leaf's last node (leaf.lastnd) or starts a chain and records the leaf (record_defined_leaf), new_web when g_build_webs, record_block_use; clears flag 0x180

name: dag_operator
note: operator whose operands all have value numbers (pp): find_equal_operator -> link_common_chain, else start_common_chain + add_operator_to_hash

name: dag_indirection
note: non-volatile indirect/qualified load that is not an assignment target: matches g_memory_refs (same op, type, base value number, offset/bit-field) -> link_common_chain, else start chain + add_memory_reference

name: dag_assignment
note: assignment/inc/dec of a variable: the leaf's lastnd becomes this node, new value number (not for post inc/dec or a converting assignment), web/use records, flag 0x180 on the previous chain end; through memory: clear, invalidate_memory_leaf_values, clear g_memory_refs (00410d00)

name: link_common_chain
note: node->cmnexp = head, inserted after head on refchn, refcnt 0, pp = head's value number (or a new one); head refcnt++ unless struct/union type

name: start_common_chain
note: refcnt 1, refchn 0, cmnexp = node, pp = ++g_value_number

name: find_equal_constant
note: bucket (val+val2+word at +0x28) mod 16 of 00450740; constants_equal; returns the stored constant or 0

name: constants_equal
note: types equal ignoring qualifiers (or same-signedness integers wider than short) and the three value words equal

name: add_constant_to_hash
note: pushes an 8-byte {next, node} cell on bucket (val+val2+word28) mod 16 of 00450740; 00410f30 on allocation failure

name: record_defined_leaf
note: pushes {next, nleaf} on g_defined_leaves (004587a8) so the leaf's lastnd can be cleared later

name: find_equal_operator
note: bucket (op + operand value numbers) mod 128 of 00458870: same op, compatible type, same operand numbers (either order when commutative, class bit 8); returns it or 0

name: add_operator_to_hash
note: pushes an 8-byte {node, next} cell on bucket (op + operand value numbers) mod 128 of 00458870

name: invalidate_memory_leaf_values
note: after a call or a store through memory: leaves that are static/implicitly volatile (flag & 5) or aggregates (symbol type 0x60/0x68/0x70) lose lastnd (flag 0x180 on the chain end) and leave g_defined_leaves

name: clear_common_links
note: refcnt, cmnexp, pp and refchn = 0

name: add_memory_reference
note: pushes {node, next} on g_memory_refs (00450780; cleared by 00410d00)

name: new_web
note: when g_build_webs: allocates a 0x20 web record into il_node+0x38: +0xc the current block (00450724), +0x10 node, +0x14 g_web_list link

name: record_block_use
note: scalar non-volatile variable reference: use number g_use_count (max 0x200) set in the leaf's use set (allocated 0x40) and the block's sets->bits_0c via FUN_00423780; debug " set block use %08x use no %d"

name: open_work_files
note: fopen (00429ce0) of the file names in g_options: +0x6c "rb" -> g_sym_file, +100 "rb" -> g_tree_in_file, +0x68 "wb" -> g_tree_out_file, +0x80 "wb" -> g_reg_file, +0x70 "rb+" -> g_swi_file; error 0xce4 on failure

name: close_work_files
note: fclose of the five files of open_work_files; error 0xce5 on failure

name: read_symbol_table
note: allocates the 0x3c-byte symbol table (count from g_options+0xb0, +1000 slack) into g_symbol_table and reads each record from g_sym_file: class +0, type +1, name_len/name +2/+0xc, +4, +6, flags +7, size +8 (aggregate types), +0x16, +0x2e, +0x38; function/class 10/flag 0x10 extras via 0040b130/0040b320/0040aed0

name: read_symbol_extension
note: called by 0040aad0 (symbol table reader) when the symbol flag byte +7 has 0x10; reads a flag byte into +0x2d; flag & 2: +0x30 (2 bytes if flag & 4, else 4); flag & 1: 4 bytes into +0x34; all reads read_or_fail(g_sym_file)

name: read_symbol_kind
note: reads 1 byte from g_sym_file; 0040aad0 stores it in symbol +0 and tests it for 1/3/9/10

name: read_symbol_kind_short
note: reads a 2-byte value only for symbol kinds 3, 4, 9, 0xb (else 0); 0040aad0 stores it in symbol +4

name: read_symbol_name_length
note: reads 1 byte; 0040aad0 passes it to read_symbol_name and stores it in symbol +2 (name_len)

name: read_symbol_name
note: FUN_0042a0e0(1,len+1) (calloc) and reads len bytes; error 0xbcd on allocation failure; stored in symbol +0xc (name)

name: read_symbol_type
note: reads 1 byte; stored in symbol +1 (type) by 0040aad0, and as the return type in read_function_info

name: read_type_size
note: reads a 4-byte size only when (type & 0xe0) >= 0x60 (struct/array kinds), else 0; stored in symbol +8 and func_info +0

name: read_symbol_byte_06
note: reads 1 byte; 0040aad0 stores it in symbol +6 (meaning unknown)

name: read_function_info
note: for kind 1/3 symbols with type 0x48: FUN_0042a0e0(1,0x14) record at sym+0x10: return size (+0) and type (+4), a byte (+5), parameter list (+6 count, +0xc array; each param's byte goes to that symbol's +3) and a second short list (+8 count, +0x10 array: scopes, see append_callee_scopes); proposed struct func_info

name: read_scope_info
note: for kind 10 symbols: 0x14-byte record at sym+0x10: child-scope list (+0 count, +4 array) and member list (+2 count, +8 array; each member's byte goes to its +3); same layout as used by add_scope_to_enclosing_block / add_member_to_scope; proposed struct scope_info

name: read_or_fail
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void read_or_fail(FILE *fp, char *buf, unsigned int size)
note: FUN_00425490(fp,buf,size); error 0xce6 when it returns -1

name: read_count_or_fail
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: unsigned int read_count_or_fail(FILE *fp, char *buf, unsigned int size)
note: same as read_or_fail but returns the count; 0040aad0 loops while it is non-zero (end of the symbol file)

name: convert_for_loops_to_do
note: recursive over child (+0x18) and next (+0x20); unless g_skip_for_to_do: a loop with repet != 0 or flag 0x8000 and not flag 0x1000: an IL_FOR node loses operands 3 and 1 (FUN_00420fa0) and becomes IL_DO, loop flag |= 0x400 (runs at least once)

name: select_loops_to_invert
note: recursive over next/child; for FOR/WHILE loops (not DO, not a FOR with an empty test) calls invert_loop_to_guarded_do when the test is a relational op (0x60..0x67) of constants or plain scalar variables (leaf flag & 0xe clear), or for any test when g_compile_info+0x20 != 0

name: invert_loop_to_guarded_do
note: orig: jdgdevlop ("jdgdevlop start/end"); for a loop whose start block has two successors: unless condition_defs_block_inversion, copies the test into a new IL_IF (FUN_00421020(0x12)) guarding the loop, turns the loop into IL_DO, rewires start/exit/pre blocks (prelst/suclst), renumbers blocks and rebuilds the CFG chains (FUN_00405150, FUN_004165e0)

name: condition_defs_block_inversion
note: recursive over the test's operands; via each operand's du table (cmnexp +0x38) counts defs in blocks numbered below lp->start and tests lp->start->domlst; nonzero = do not invert (caller 0040b790 tests the low byte only; recursion adds low bytes)

name: find_dt_opt_loops
note: recursive over child/next; for loops with repet != 0 and lstep 1 or -1 sets g_dt_loop and g_dt_cond (the test; a FOR's 4th operand) and calls convert_loop_to_decrement_test unless the test is already "!= 0" with step -1 or is LE/GE

name: convert_loop_to_decrement_test
note: orig: dt_opt ("dt_opt start/end"); from the du table of the compared variable finds the single def inside the loop (the step) and the single def before it (the init), checks block_has_no_other_var_ref for the loop blocks, then rewrite_loop_count_down (mode 2 when the variable is used outside the loop); loop flag |= 0x100 when a second def is found

name: block_has_no_other_var_ref
note: runs tree_has_no_other_var_ref over block->ilnode statements until one fails

name: tree_has_no_other_var_ref
